name: ClassTableInheritance
summary: A hierarchy of classes mapped to one table per class, joined on the key.

roles.name: ClassTableInheritance
roles.summary: The root of a hierarchy stored as one table per class, each holding only its own fields and joined to its parent. It is the mapping that keeps the schema honest — no nullable column that exists for another subclass — and it pays for that with a join per level on every read.
